target_customer: Software teams that ship web products and need QA
problem: Manual and scripted QA is slow and brittle, and bugs reach users because teams cannot test every flow.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for autonomous browser agent testing

founders.name: Marc Papazian
founders.background_notes: Led the operational data backbone for a federal pandemic response at Palantir and was Director of Product at an AI startup per YC.

founders.name: Matt White
founders.background_notes: Senior engineer at Airtable building infrastructure that reduced manual QA.

competitors.name: Testsigma
competitors.what: Autonomous testing agents that generate and run browser tests

competitors.name: BrowserStack
competitors.what: Suite of AI agents across the testing lifecycle

technical_complexity.rationale: Browser agents that explore products, run flows and report reproducible bugs need reliable agent loops, but rely on existing models and browser automation.

defensibility.rationale: Many teams and incumbents shipped similar agentic QA in 2025, and the approach rests on shared foundation models.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Datadog acquired Propolis, announced 27 January 2026, to fold it into its platform.

market_need_then: Agentic AI products are nondeterministic and hard to test with scripts, and Datadog framed quality as a continuous signal. Two person teams had little QA capacity.

branding.domain_note: Uses propolis.tech, not propolis.com (website field). Site could not be fetched from this session.

identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and goal focused: hands off QA via intelligent browser agents

branding.community_and_virality: A Product Hunt listing exists. The CEO's YC bio mentions keeping bees, which fits the name, but no source states the name origin.

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable bee related word but a crowded namespace with a tokenized real estate company and health product brands, and little brand press.

outcome_analysis: Propolis went from YC Spring 2025 to an acquisition by Datadog announced in January 2026, less than a year after its batch. A two person team with Palantir and Airtable backgrounds built autonomous QA agents as testing for agentic software became urgent, and Datadog bought the capability and team rather than waiting. Deal terms are not public.

Acquisition date from DBTA article of 2026-01-29 and YC page stating 27 January 2026. Datadog primary press release not read. Completeness pass: the June 2025 pre-seed of about 500K is now recorded as a round; it rests on a single database (VCBacked) and the amount is not confirmed by press or a filing.
